daily_kpi: This distinct real-data backtest completed on UTC date 2026-11-26; the 2026-11-26 minimum was already met by the earlier STLFSI4 and SOFR-EFFR real-data backtests.
data_scope: FRED VXNCLS/VIXCLS daily from 2016-11-25 to 2026-11-24 (common end 2026-11-24); SP500 2016-11-28 to 2026-11-24; 415 accepted non-overlapping six-session-spaced events; validation 2019-2021; test 2022 onward
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — evidence is mixed, statistically uncertain or insufficient under the frozen decision rule

event_construction.signal_rule: S&P 500 close on t; latest common VXN/VIX observation dated strictly before t
event_construction.spread_feature: log(VXN/VIX)[d] - log(VXN/VIX)[d-5], where d is the latest common date strictly before t
event_construction.vol_observation_lag: strictly prior common date; no same-date VXN/VIX values are used

limitations: VXN and VIX are current FRED vintages; historical point-in-time CBOE dissemination and later revisions are not reconstructed.

VXN measures Nasdaq-100 implied volatility while VIX measures S&P 500 implied volatility; their ratio can reflect sector concentration, index composition and relative option demand rather than a pure spillover shock.
The strict prior-date rule avoids same-date publication look-ahead but does not reconstruct intraday historical publication timestamps.
The baseline controls for broad VIX level and recent S&P 500 realized volatility, but not every cross-index or sector-specific risk factor.
SP500 is a cash price index, not an executable futures series or total-return index.
Forecasting only: no causal claim, transaction-cost model, tradable strategy or live-deployment conclusion.
No raw source data are committed; only URLs, retrieval metadata, hashes and aggregate metrics are retained.

methodology.availability: VXN and VIX are used only from their latest common date strictly before the signal date
methodology.feature: log(VXN/VIX)[d] - log(VXN/VIX)[d-5]; d is the latest common VXN/VIX observation strictly before the signal date
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-session S&P 500 realized volatility in percent)
methodology.training_rule: training target_end_date must be strictly earlier than current signal_date
